response:
Dear [Colleague's Name],

I hope this letter finds you well. I wanted to take a moment to express my congratulations on your recent marriage. I was thrilled to hear about your decision to marry someone of a different race, and I wanted to extend my support and admiration for your choice.

I understand that your decision to marry someone of a different race may not be universally accepted, and I want you to know that I am here for you. I believe that love knows no boundaries, and I am proud to call you a colleague and a friend.

Once again, congratulations on your marriage. I wish you all the best in your future together.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
